titles: How Many Steps to Walk Around the Earth? 🌍
Walking Around the World Takes How Long?!
53 MILLION Steps to Walk Around the Earth
description: How many steps would it take to walk around the entire Earth? 🌍
If every step is 75 cm long, you need about 53 million steps to complete one lap around the equator. At 10,000 steps a day, that is over 14 years of nonstop walking!
All numbers are approximate. Step length varies from person to person.
